study: Prospective fixed-geometry large-scale shadow aging and reduced planning fidelity
geometry: Per-trajectory fixed path-loss mean, stationary covariance and pairing. New payloads at each frame uniform 0.85 to 1.15 times nominal, paired across all methods and speeds.
law: Stationary multivariate Gaussian AR(1); rho=exp(-v*T/10). Report x_t at start, serve true x_(t+1). Posterior persists across every frame and refresh; no execution labels used to learn. No small-scale fading or flight data.
rules: IVP and sensitivity make a one-step certificate-based report/stop decision on refresh frames only. Fixed-IVP always buys exactly one report, using the highest one-step certificate Q even if stopping would be preferred. Nonrefresh frames buy zero reports. Both terminal allocators are evaluated from the same history. No-report skips acquisition.
cost: Primary: whole report airtime and one or two hypothetical per-round costs on the refresh frame; no acquisition charge on other frames. Common terminal work excluded. 1.72 ms is the historical certificate ratio used as an assumed charge.
primary_contrasts: IVP, sensitivity, fixed-IVP each minus no-report and IVP minus sensitivity for every speed, K, cost and terminal. Simultaneous Bonferroni paired t, two sided, 95%, paired mean kbit/frame per independent 40-frame trajectory; outages descriptive.

host.common_reserve: 1.25 times development 95th percentile of one warmed no-report terminal, rounded upward to 0.1 ms. Held fixed for all held-out frames. Evaluation is serial, one BLAS thread, warm-up excluded. Time includes acquisition, posterior update and final allocation, excludes scenario generation and execution scoring.
host.deadline: Every frame pays common terminal reserve. Refresh frames additionally pay c per report/stop round and radio airtime if accepted. A late decision earns zero service. On an overrun a newly acquired observation is discarded before posterior carry-forward. No-report pays the common reserve and is penalized identically.
host.family: Two direct IVP-minus-no-report trajectory contrasts, one per K, simultaneous 95%. No tuning of reservations on test data.

profile.cells: Full 3x3 planning grid. Same planning stream, each stopping step conditional on observed reports; final stream independent and shared across methods. Acceptance threshold recalculated for planning draw count.
profile.timing: Two runs per frame and cell on one pinned CPU, randomized within frame. (1) Radio-only service and warmed whole-decision wall time. (2) All methods including no-report receive a 1.0-ms total computation reservation on the 20-ms frame. Subtract this before planning; active overruns earn zero. Time stops after final validation, before truth-based service scoring.
profile.statistic: 18 simultaneous Bonferroni 95% paired contrasts vs identical no-report terminal (9 each at 0 and 1 ms). A 1-ms operating point requires empirical whole-decision p95 at most 1 ms AND a positive charged-service lower limit.

streams: NumPy independent SeedSequence namespaces for AR shocks, report errors and per-frame payloads. The same standardized input streams pair the speed scenarios. Frame-specific final-gate seeds are disjoint from all geometry and observation seeds.
